train_vae: train a VAE model on MSA data with homolog sequences and architecture hyperparameters
save_vae_model: save a trained VAE model and its metadata including homolog config to disk
load_vae_model: load a previously saved VAE model and homolog config from a model directory path
get_likelihood_scores: compute likelihood scores of aligned sequences under a trained VAE model
test_msa_vae: test the msa_vae module functions including training saving loading and likelihood scoring
